verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents official SDKs/tools (Checkout SDK, API Clients library, design system SDK) plus REST/GraphQL APIs, sandboxes, and API account setup, giving AI-native builders a well-documented path to build against first-party SDKs. Community reports of API throttling/incomplete ecosystem introduce some quality caveats but don't contradict SDK existence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK reliability/quality and AI-specific SDK usage examples.
